transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: The Airport Flyer A1 bus runs to Bristol via Bedminster, Bristol Temple Meads and Bristol Bus Station. It operates around the clock, except on Christmas Day; timetables vary during the festive period. An adult single ticket costs £9.50. Tickets can be bought online or from the driver when boarding.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: The Escape Lounge is on the mezzanine level of the departure lounge, after security and Duty Free. It opens daily from 03:30 to 19:30; advance bookings start at £39.99 per person. Hot and cold food, drinks and Wi-Fi are included. Stays are limited to 3 hours before scheduled departure and depend on check-in, bag-drop and lounge opening times.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.hint: Hampton by Hilton by the terminal
sleep.text: Hampton by Hilton is on the airport site, a few minutes’ walk from check-in, with a walkway to the terminal. The hotel provides complimentary hot breakfast and Wi-Fi. Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The Waiting Zone offers up to 1 hour of free parking for picking up, dropping off or waiting for a passenger. Charges apply at the separate Drop Off & Pick Up car park. Returning to the Waiting Zone within 30 minutes is prohibited and automatically results in a Parking Charge Notice.

about: Bristol Airport is linked to the city by the Airport Flyer A1 bus. The route serves Bristol Temple Meads and Bristol Bus Station.
